name: personal-ai-os
description: A personal AI Operating System — Next.js + Supabase + Claude, with a per-module Telegram bot, that runs one person's tasks, career, finances, health, learning, and coding practice through a single daily Life Score.

paragraphs: A personal, single-user AI Operating System: one Next.js app that tracks interview prep, career, money, health, coding practice, and a personal knowledge base — with Claude generating insight in every module, a per-module Telegram bot for hands-free logging (text, voice, or photo), scheduled proactive nudges, and a gamified "Life Score" that rolls all of it into one daily number.

This document describes exactly what the app does today, module by module, field by field, formula by formula, so it can be pasted into a fresh AI chat and give that AI complete understanding of the system with no other context needed. It is kept current with every functional change (see CLAUDE.md's post-task checklist).

Status: this is a personal project built for one person's specific life and workflow — not a product, and not designed for multi-tenant use. It's open-sourced as a working example of an AI-assisted personal system (Next.js + Supabase + Claude + Telegram), not as a tool meant to be deployed as-is for someone else's life. Fork it, borrow the patterns you like, adapt the modules you don't need.

requirements.text: Exception: an account less than 7 days old averages only over the days that exist since signup (user.createdat), so a brand-new account's first week isn't crushed toward 0 by pre-signup days.
Unauthenticated users on a page route are redirected to /login; authenticated users hitting /login are redirected to /dashboard (the landing page; was /planner until Planner was removed 2026-10-07).
